description: String-only canonicalization vectors proving that canonically equivalent NFC and NFD sequences are preserved as distinct JSON strings and therefore produce distinct canonical UTF-8 bytes and SHA-256 digests. These are reference vectors, not evidence that a TuskerOS runtime canonicalizer exists.

cases.name: precomposed Latin small letter e with acute
decomposed Latin small letter e followed by combining acute

invariant: A JCS implementation MUST preserve each parsed JSON string exactly. It MUST NOT normalize the two values to the same byte sequence.
